description:
## Background

The repository's canonical quality gate, `mise run verify`, currently fails on the clean `main` branch even though the TypeScript and Rust test suites pass. The failures prevent the repository from establishing a green baseline and will make the planned PR-triggered CI workflow report failure for every change.

The failures fall into two independently implementable areas:

1. TypeScript 7 rejects the obsolete `baseUrl` compiler option in `tsconfig.json`.
2. Ultracite reports formatting and lint violations across existing source, test, E2E, and documentation files.

Rust formatting, Clippy, Rust tests, and Vitest currently pass.

## What to build

Restore a green repository quality gate through two child tasks:

- Migrate the TypeScript configuration to the TypeScript 7-compatible shape.
- Resolve the current Ultracite formatting and lint findings without weakening the configured rules.

The completed epic is verified by a successful `mise run verify`.

## Technical Approach

The child tasks are independent and may be implemented in either order. Keep the TypeScript compiler configuration migration separate from the formatting/lint cleanup so each change has a focused cause and verification path.

```mermaid
graph LR
    A["Migrate TypeScript 7 configuration"] --> V["mise run verify passes"]
    B["Resolve Ultracite violations"] --> V
```

## Considerations

- `mise.toml` is the canonical quality-task graph; use `mise run` tasks rather than invoking package scripts or raw tools directly for validation.
- Preserve application behavior, generated RPC contracts, and test intent.
- Do not silence lint rules or broadly disable checks merely to obtain a green result.
- The existing Rust and test suites are passing and should remain passing.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Both child tasks are complete.
- [ ] `mise run verify` passes without suppressing the reported TypeScript or Ultracite failures.
- [ ] Existing TypeScript, Rust, and E2E test intent remains unchanged.

## Test Plan

- Run the focused verification command for each child task.
- Run the full canonical gate: `mise run verify`.
- Confirm the working tree contains only the intended quality-compliance changes.

## Triage

ready-for-agent
title: Restore repository quality gate compliance
